name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 10 - Am 67
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 10 b. Underlines that the salaries and benefits of Commissioners, Members and the President of the Council are very generous; is concerned that such disproportionately high salaries completely alienate those people from everyday lives, needs and struggles; considers, therefore, that allocating more reasonable salaries and benefits would increase the chance of the 2026 Budget proposals being more in line with the needs of working people;
